verdict: Ads went dark mid-week; leads and cost efficiency still improved this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 30 leads at a cost of $46.95 per lead, and the most recent active week showed a 64% improvement in cost per lead alongside a 25% rise in lead volume — a real efficiency gain. That progress was cut short when the Meta campaign stopped running entirely for four consecutive days (September 9–12), producing zero leads during that window. Restoring the campaign to full delivery is the immediate priority this week. Separately, your intake pipeline shows 24 contacts recorded against 30 leads reported by Meta, with no opportunities created from either group; we are working to close that gap so arriving leads convert into active cases. Once paid delivery is stable, you should see lead volume recover and the cost-per-lead improvement carry forward.
